newsitem.title: USA: TVA to stop Ala. Power litigation.
newsitem.headline: TVA to stop Ala. Power litigation.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) said on Thursday it would not continue litigation with Southern Co's Alabama Power, regarding power sales to LG&E Power Marketing Inc.

TVA Chairman Craven Crowell said the two companies agreed to hold informal talks regarding their business operations, and that continuing litigation was not in the best interests of TVA or Alabama Power customers.

Crowell said he accepted an invitation from Alabama Power President Elmer Harris to meet to discuss issues of mutual concern facing the utility industry and opportunities for better cooperation between the two companies.
Alabama Power had tried to block TVA sales to LG&E, TVA said.
